Name: Chasing The Ice Cream Truck
Author: CosmicSweetpea
Description:
[b]Chasing The Ice Cream Truck by CosmicSweetpea[/b]

Ya'll remember chasing the ice cream truck as a kid? Hell I still do it now. Chasing the Ice Cream Truck adds a collection of nostalgic frozen treats to Stardew Valley, inspired by childhood summers, neighborhood ice cream trucks, and sticky fingers racing down the street before the truck disappeared around the corner. Visit the Summer Ice Cream Stand to find a rotating collection of classic novelty bars, frozen desserts, ice cream cones, frappes, and shaved ice.  🛒 Available at Alex's ice cream stall during the summer.
